# Journal of Posthumanism

> A peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal publishing interdisciplinary research on posthumanism, technology, and society with global indexation.

The Journal of Posthumanism (ISSN 2634-3576/2634-3584) is an open-access, peer-reviewed publication indexed in Scopus and Web of Science. The journal publishes research spanning posthuman innovation, digital behavior, health sciences, institutional studies, and legal analysis from international contributors.

## Current Issues & Publications

- [Vol. 6 No. 3 (2026)](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/issue/current): Current volume 6 issue 3 of Journal of Posthumanism (2026)
- [Reimagining Research Commercialisation through Posthuman Innovation](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4069): Bibliometric study of posthuman innovation ecologies and research
- [Transforming Supply Chain Operations through AI and Machine Learning](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4059): Article on AI/ML for demand forecasting and inventory optimization
- [Integrating Local Cultural Values into Digital Financial Behavior](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4035): Article on Tri Kaya Parisudha and e-money reuse in Bali, Indonesia

## Research Articles

- [Assessment of Obesity, Comorbidities and Associated Factors](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4053): Health study on obesity and comorbidities in Dhaka City women aged 35-45
- [Weight Regain After Discontinuation of High-Dose GLP-1 Agonists](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4054): Meta-analysis of weight regain after GLP-1 receptor agonist discontinuation
- [Institutional Trust and Parental Safety Appraisal](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4055): Study on institutional trust in Arab Schools in Israel
- [Career Plateauing as A Predictor of Turnover Intention](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4058): Study on career plateauing and job satisfaction in Nigeria schools
- [The Authority of the Constitutional Judiciary in Reviewing](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4038): Comparative study on constitutional judiciary authority and amendments
- [Risk-Based Counterparty Due Diligence Framework](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4056): Case study of PT Pertamina crude segment compliance framework
- [Assessing the Risks to Nuclear Safety](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4070): Case study on nuclear safety and Indonesia research agency reform
- [Relationship Between Amnesty and Prosecution](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4071): Legal analysis of amnesty, prosecution and private prosecution
- [Analysis of Tourists' Perceptions of Kosovo's Tourism Locations](https://posthumanism.co.uk/jp/article/view/4072): Study on information accessibility for Kosovo tourism destinations
